svg.title: Azure DevOps CI/CD Architecture — React App Deployment
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing developer commit triggering a 4-stage Azure Pipeline that deploys a React app to an Azure Ubuntu VM running Nginx

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the developer do in a CI/CD workflow?')
sendPrompt('What happens in the Build stage of the pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What happens in the Test stage of the pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the Publish stage do in Azure Pipelines?')
sendPrompt('What happens in the Deploy stage?')
sendPrompt('What is a pipeline artifact in Azure DevOps?')
sendPrompt('How does a self-hosted Azure DevOps agent work?')
sendPrompt('What is an SSH service connection in Azure DevOps?')
sendPrompt('How does Nginx serve a React app?')
sendPrompt('What files does the React build put in /var/www/html?')
sendPrompt('How does a browser load a React app served by Nginx?')
